title: Derangements OQ-03-OQ-02: Third-Order Asymptotic Expansion
description: Extends the derangements convergence hierarchy to a two-correction asymptotic expansion: |D(n)/n! - 1/e - (-1)^n/(n+1)! - (-1)^(n+1)/(n+2)!| ≤ 1/(n+3)!. The proof applies the tail-splitting lemma from OQ-03-OQ-01 twice, using cancellation lemmas for each correction term, then bounds the residual via alternating_tail_bound.

meta.author: Montmort (1708), Euler (1751); asymptotic expansion by researcher-3
meta.assumptions: No axioms. Fully proved from Mathlib, building on DerangementsOQ03's infrastructure (altFactTerm, altFactPartialSum, alternating_tail_bound, tsum_tail_split).
originalContributions: asymptotic_expansion_two_corrections: rephrasing as proximity to 3-term expansion
corrections_alternate_sign: sign pattern of consecutive corrections

overview.historicalContext: The derangements problem (Montmort 1708, Euler 1751) gives D(n) = n! · ∑_{k=0}^{n} (-1)^k/k!. The convergence D(n)/n! → 1/e was studied with increasing precision: the first error bound |D(n)/n! - 1/e| ≤ 1/(n+1)! (OQ-03), the second-order correction (-1)^n/(n+1)! with residual ≤ 1/(n+2)! (OQ-03-OQ-01), and now the third-order correction (-1)^(n+1)/(n+2)! with residual ≤ 1/(n+3)!.
overview.problemStatement: Extend the asymptotic expansion of D(n)/n! around 1/e to include two correction terms, bounding the residual by 1/(n+3)!
overview.text: The third-order asymptotic expansion: D(n)/n! = 1/e + (-1)^n/(n+1)! + (-1)^(n+1)/(n+2)! + R_n where |R_n| ≤ 1/(n+3)!. The corrections alternate in sign. The proof uses two tail-splits of the alternating series for e^{-1} and two algebraic cancellations.
overview.proofStrategy: Three steps: (1) write D(n)/n! - 1/e = -(tail from n+1); (2) split twice: tail(n+1) = altFactTerm(n+1) + altFactTerm(n+2) + tail(n+3); (3) the two corrections cancel with -altFactTerm(n+1) and -altFactTerm(n+2) via linear_combination. The residual -tail(n+3) is bounded by 1/(n+3)! via alternating_tail_bound.
keyInsights: linear_combination closes the algebraic simplification cleanly after two tail splits

conclusion.summary: The third-order asymptotic expansion D(n)/n! = 1/e + (-1)^n/(n+1)! + (-1)^(n+1)/(n+2)! + R_n with |R_n| ≤ 1/(n+3)! is fully proved. The proof is 0 sorries, 0 axioms, and reuses infrastructure from OQ-03 and OQ-03-OQ-01.
conclusion.implications: This continues the derangements convergence hierarchy. The k-th order expansion has residual 1/(n+k+1)! and corrections (-1)^(n+j)/(n+j)! for j = 1, ..., k. The pattern is uniform and can be extended to any order by induction on k.
